about: Figure-type ID -> the bundle tool that draws it. IDs are the Manuscript Figure Catalog IDs used across the papers. tools/gen_figure_options.py turns this into docs/FIGURE_OPTIONS.generated.md and docs/figure_options.generated.json.

common.help: printed width in inches (3.5 single column, 7.2 double); text is held at 8 pt or more at that width
smallest printed text size in points (house floor 8)
genus colour overlay from mamey/data/genus_palette.json (moss, attine; bee uses the default set)
PNG resolution; the PDF is vector
new output folder or stem; tools refuse to overwrite
adds the croppable caption band and the caption sidecar (house convention)
checks text size, captions and wording before anyone uses a figure

figures.name: 16S similarity to the closest type strain
figures.draws: Histogram of each isolate's 16S rRNA gene identity to its nearest type strain, coloured by genus.

figures.name: Within-genus pairwise 16S identity
figures.draws: Pairwise 16S identity between isolates of the same genus: one panel per genus, or all genera overlaid.

figures.name: dDDH with the closest type strain
figures.draws: Digital DDH (d4) of each sequenced isolate with its closest type strain, with confidence intervals.

figures.name: 16S identity against dDDH
figures.draws: Scatter of 16S identity against dDDH, with the 98.65% and 70% thresholds.

figures.name: Genera by isolation source
figures.draws: Genus composition of the isolates in each isolation-source group.

figures.name: BGC classes by group
figures.draws: antiSMASH region classes summed over the isolates of each group.

figures.name: BGC classes per genome
figures.draws: antiSMASH region classes of each genome, with contig-edge counts.

figures.name: Biosynthetic protein identity against genus references
figures.draws: Each isolate's region proteins against reference genomes of its genus.
figures.note: Codex card waiting on its rebase onto page_defaults.

figures.name: Gene cluster families in public genomes
figures.draws: BiG-SCAPE families of each isolate, split by whether a public genome of the genus shares the family.

figures.name: Gene cluster family trees
figures.draws: Per-family synteny trees of an isolate's regions among public genomes and MIBiG.

figures.name: Locus maps against the closest characterized cluster
figures.draws: Reference cluster above the isolate's matching genes, matched genes joined by identity bands, genes elsewhere in the genome drawn beside the core.

figures.name: Activity by genus
figures.draws: Bioassay results by target organism and genus, four states kept (+, -, n.t., blank).

figures.name: Strong activity by source
figures.draws: Heat map of strong activity by target and isolation source.

figures.name: Paenibacillus larvae against MRSA
figures.draws: Scatter of inhibition of P. larvae against MRSA.

figures.name: Candida against MRSA
figures.draws: Scatter of Candida inhibition against MRSA, crude extracts or fractions.

figures.name: Strong activity, Streptomyces against other genera
figures.draws: Share of strongly active isolates, Streptomyces against other genera, with n under each bar.

figures.name: BLASTp identity of BGC genes, by genome (and P02 by class)
figures.draws: Mean identity of the top 10 BLASTp hits of each region gene, per genome; --figure by-class draws P02.

figures.name: Protein PCoA pages
figures.draws: Ordination of one protein class: cohort proteins among reference and MIBiG proteins.

figures.name: TriMap or t-SNE of saved coordinates
figures.draws: Replays saved TriMap or t-SNE coordinates from a hash-bound manifest.

figures.name: Chitin genes, isolates against references
figures.draws: Chitinase and chitin-binding gene counts of each isolate beside the reference genomes of its genus.
